item.title: Rare meteorite identified as the cause of dinosaur extinction
item.description:
The asteroid that wiped out dinosaurs was likely a rare CO chondrite from a distant solar region. Its unique chemistry suggests planet-cooling dust and debris caused the mass extinction.

item.description:

item.title: Antidepressant fluvoxamine may reduce long COVID fatigue
item.description:
A clinical trial involving 399 adults found that fluvoxamine significantly reduces fatigue and improves quality of life. This low-cost medication is among the first to show meaningful benefits for long COVID symptoms.

item.title: Sugar substitutes linked to faster cognitive aging
item.description:
High consumption of artificial sweeteners is associated with accelerated declines in memory and thinking. This effect was most notable in individuals under 60 or those with diabetes, though researchers call for more studies to confirm causality.

item.title: Asteroid breakup may have bombarded Earth 800 million years ago
item.description:
A catastrophic asteroid breakup likely sent debris toward Earth, the Moon, and Mars 800 million years ago. This bombardment may explain ancient lunar craters and significant biological changes on Earth.

item.title: Volcanic activity transformed oceanic plate 100 million years ago
item.description:
Seismic waves reveal that massive volcanic activity transformed the oceanic plate beneath the Ontong Java Plateau. Researchers discovered complex magma channels and chemical alterations caused by deep-rising magma.

item.title: Intermittent fasting aids long-term weight maintenance
item.description:
A 12-week intermittent fasting program showed lasting weight-loss benefits after one year. Participants using an eight-hour eating window maintained more weight loss than those with standard schedules.
